# SECC: South Of England Curling Club

> > Official website for the South Of England Curling Club (SECC), promoting Olympic curling in South England with beginner courses, member resources, and competition updates.

SECC is an amateur curling club affiliated with the English Curling Association and Team GB, offering learn-to-curl programs at venues like Fenton's Rink and Tunbridge Wells. The site provides comprehensive guides for beginners, competition results from events like the Kent & Sussex Bonspiel and ECA Championships, and essential curling terminology.

## Key Topics

- SECC (South Of England Curling Club)
- Learn to Curl programs
- Curling terminology and glossary
- Sweeping techniques
- English Curling Association
- Team GB curling
- Kent & Sussex Bonspiel
- Fenton's Rink
- Tunbridge Wells curling venue
- Dumfries Ice Bowl
- Curling equipment (stopwatch, measuring)
- Blank end strategy
- ECA Championships
- Beginner curling courses
- Olympic curling sport

## Getting Started

- [Members - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/aboutus): About SECC: amateur curling club promoting Olympic sport in South England
- [Learn To Curl - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/learn-to-curl): Beginner curling course: 2-session program at £50 with experienced coaches
- [Glossary - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/learn-to-curl/glossary): A-Z curling terminology glossary with specialist sport definitions

## Learn To Curl Guides

- [Learn To Curl: Sweeping - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2022/01/learn-to-curl-sweeping): Sweeping technique guide: brush mechanics and stone control explained
- [Learn To Curl: End - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2021/10/learn-to-curl-end): End basics: curling game structure with 8-10 rounds per match
- [Learn To Curl: Stopwatch - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2021/11/learn-to-curl-stopwatch): Guide to using stopwatches for timing stone speed in curling
- [Learn To Curl: Measuring - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2022/04/learn-to-curl-measuring): Measuring procedures: determining closest stone to button after end
- [Learn To Curl: Blank End - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2022/02/learn-to-curl-blank-end): Blank end strategy: retaining hammer when no points scored

## Competition News & Results

- [Kent & Sussex Bonspiel: Nov 21/22/23 2025 – RESULTS - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2025/06/kent-sussex-bonspiel-nov-21-22-23-2025): Kent & Sussex Bonspiel results: Van Dijck team wins at Tunbridge Wells
- [ECA Men's Championship: Feb 24-27 2022 - SECC: South Of England Curling Club](https://secc.rocks/2021/11/eca-mens-championship-feb-24-27-2022): 2022 ECA Men's National Championship draw at Dumfries Ice Bowl with SECC teams
